description: List every DeFi cover analysis Cover Raccoon has scored (Nexus Mutual products and more). FREE catalog: per cover it returns the Assecura score (0-100) and band, the covered protocol, coverage-gap counts (covered / partial / excluded), the red-flag count, the cheapest annual premium snapshot, and the analysis date (asOf). Use it to discover which covers exist and their headline verdict, then call reputa_cover_analysis for the full report. Note: this and the three sibling reputa_cover_* tools also live in the dedicated coverraccoon-mcp package under shorter names (cover_list, cover_analysis, cover_check, cover_buy_quote) - same API, same behaviour. Both keep working; reputa_cover_* stays here for existing agent configurations.
name: reputa_cover_list
